Practice withdrawal without an enemy. Regroup at the fallback position and check no soldier remains behind.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d62000000000004.title: TaCZ — firearms and ammunition
wargame.quests.6d62000000001300.title: Gunsmith table
wargame.quests.6d62000000001300.descript:
Available firearms depend on installed gun packs. Match ammunition and attachments to your weapon. Quests do not give free weapons.

Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001301.title: First firearm
wargame.quests.6d62000000001301.descript:
Complete the practical goal and check it manually. There is no automatic world-state detection.

Craft an available firearm and check its caliber and ammunition recipe. Confirm manually: different models share a base item with different NBT.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001302.title: Your caliber reserve
wargame.quests.6d62000000001302.descript:
Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.

Automatic detection counts any TaCZ ammo. Check caliber compatibility yourself.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001303.title: Training target
wargame.quests.6d62000000001303.descript: Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001304.title: Reloading and range
wargame.quests.6d62000000001304.descript:
Complete the practical goal and check it manually. There is no automatic world-state detection.

Test firing, reloading and keybindings on a safe range. Compare recoil and shooting from cover.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001305.title: Compatible attachment
wargame.quests.6d62000000001305.descript:
Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.

This detects any attachment. Verify compatibility in the weapon interface.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001048.title: Marked firing range
wargame.quests.6d63000000001048.descript:
Prepare targets. Mark distances and a safe firing direction away from residents.

Items are not consumed. Inventory detection does not verify installation or equipment operation.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001049.title: Weapon zeroing
wargame.quests.6d63000000001049.descript:
Test the weapon at several distances. Record a useful distance and recoil behavior for your configuration.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104a.title: Team ammunition
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104a.descript:
Prepare ammunition stock. This task accepts any NBT; manually verify each player’s weapon compatibility.

Items are not consumed. Inventory detection does not verify installation or equipment operation.
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104b.title: Caliber-sorted storage
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104b.descript:
Sort ammunition into labeled containers. Verify reserve ammunition matches the team’s weapons.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104c.title: Attachment selection
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104c.descript:
Prepare attachments and inspect compatible weapon slots. The generic item does not guarantee the right attachment type.

Items are not consumed. Inventory detection does not verify installation or equipment operation.
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104d.title: Two-loadout comparison
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104d.descript:
Compare two attachment sets on the same targets. Choose for your role, not simply the highest price.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104e.title: Field gunsmith point
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104e.descript:
Prepare a second gunsmith table for a supply base. Owning it does not automate ammunition production.

Items are not consumed. Inventory detection does not verify installation or equipment operation.
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104f.title: Team field drill
wargame.quests.6d6300000000104f.descript:
Agree roles and reload procedure, run a field drill and report ammunition expenditure.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d62000000000008.title: Warium — industry and enemy
wargame.quests.6d62000000001700.title: Warium tools
wargame.quests.6d62000000001700.descript:
Players may use Warium industry; our director controls the invasion. This book does not start extra robot spawning. HQ sets the enemy’s RP name; Warium here identifies the mod.

Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001701.title: Steel production
wargame.quests.6d62000000001701.descript: Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001702.title: Military metalworking
wargame.quests.6d62000000001702.descript: Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001703.title: Foundry
wargame.quests.6d62000000001703.descript: Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001704.title: Fuel processing
wargame.quests.6d62000000001704.descript: Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001705.title: Field fortifications
wargame.quests.6d62000000001705.descript: Obtain the listed quantity. Check JEI for recipes and sources. Items are not consumed; owning them does not verify machine operation.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001706.title: Recognize enemy forces
wargame.quests.6d62000000001706.descript:
Complete the practical goal and check it manually. There is no automatic world-state detection.

Observe infantry, mortar units, commanders and aircraft from a safe distance. Players record recon. No spawn eggs or enemy summoning are required.
wargame.quests.6d62000000001707.title: Counterattack and hold
wargame.quests.6d62000000001707.descript:
Complete the practical goal and check it manually. There is no automatic world-state detection.

Clear a small zone with your team, review control on the map and prepare defenses. Coordinate with the GM before enabling another mod’s capture system.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001050.title: Steel batch
wargame.quests.6d63000000001050.descript:
Prepare Warium steel using its recipes. Different mods’ steel is not always interchangeable.

Items are not consumed. Inventory detection does not verify installation or equipment operation.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001051.title: Steelworks chain
wargame.quests.6d63000000001051.descript:
Trace steel from raw materials to storage and produce a repeatable batch. Use JEI for your version.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001052.title: Production wiring
wargame.quests.6d63000000001052.descript:
Produce Warium copper wire. It is a mod item, not a universally compatible energy cable.

Items are not consumed. Inventory detection does not verify installation or equipment operation.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001053.title: Metal processing
wargame.quests.6d63000000001053.descript:
Choose an available metal-parts recipe and produce stock. Record required inputs instead of relying on memory.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001054.title: Steel panels
wargame.quests.6d63000000001054.descript:
Prepare panels for an engineering project. They do not guarantee protection against every ammunition type.

Items are not consumed. Inventory detection does not verify installation or equipment operation.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001055.title: Warium fuel reserve
wargame.quests.6d63000000001055.descript:
Check available fuel processing and storage. Do not mix different mods’ fuels without testing compatibility.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001056.title: Engineering reserve
wargame.quests.6d63000000001056.descript:
Prepare sandbags for player-built fortifications.

Items are not consumed. Inventory detection does not verify installation or equipment operation.
wargame.quests.6d63000000001057.title: Fortification test
wargame.quests.6d63000000001057.descript:
Test your cover with available weapons in a world copy. Check access, visibility and damage; do not fire at the occupied base.

Confirm this practical objective manually after completing it; the world is not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d66000000000001.title: MSOS — military network and map
wargame.quests.6d66000000001000.title: MSOS — where to download
wargame.quests.6d66000000001000.descript:
MSOS is the pack author's military system for CC:Tweaked. Official repository: https://github.com/ZonaCZO/Military-system. Read the README for current installation instructions. Crafting a computer does not automatically install the program.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001001.title: Headquarters computer
wargame.quests.6d66000000001001.descript:
Prepare an advanced computer for MSOS. Use separate computers for the program's server and commander workstation.

Items are not consumed; verify program installation yourself.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001002.title: Wireless network
wargame.quests.6d66000000001002.descript:
Attach a wireless modem for MSOS communications. Test range and interference in your world; owning a modem does not verify connectivity.

Items are not consumed; verify program installation yourself.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001003.title: Download the installer
wargame.quests.6d66000000001003.descript:
In the CC computer terminal run: wget run https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZonaCZO/Military-system/main/install/install.lua. This comes from the project's README and is not a Minecraft chat command. Downloading needs HTTP enabled by the host; the modem serves the in-game network, not HTTP downloads.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001004.title: Install the MSOS server
wargame.quests.6d66000000001004.descript:
Choose the server role in the installer on a dedicated computer. This is an in-game program server, not a requirement to rent a separate Minecraft server.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001005.title: Install the workstation
wargame.quests.6d66000000001005.descript:
Run the same installer on another computer and choose commander system. Follow the installed version's launch instructions and keep client and server versions compatible.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001006.title: Configure .net_config
wargame.quests.6d66000000001006.descript:
Configure networking through the installed system's .net_config. Match the client to the existing server; do not introduce a separate state ID just for the map.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001007.title: Login and authorization
wargame.quests.6d66000000001007.descript:
Use existing MSOS authentication with your group's account. Keep passwords private. An RP title or MSOS account does not replace KubeJS GM permissions.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001008.title: Open the military map
wargame.quests.6d66000000001008.descript:
Open the map from the installed program's menu. Find yourself and a known zone and compare world coordinates. If OFFLINE, check networking, the program server and authentication before confirming success.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d66000000001009.title: Teammate connectivity test
wargame.quests.6d66000000001009.descript:
Connect a second allied workstation to the same server. Compare map information and any shared markers supported by your version. Check the current README if a feature is unavailable and never treat stale information as current.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
wargame.quests.6d6600000000100a.title: MSOS backups
wargame.quests.6d6600000000100a.descript:
Prepare disks for program and configuration backups. Back up server data separately and restrict access to media containing secrets.

Items are not consumed; verify program installation yourself.
wargame.quests.6d6600000000100b.title: Update without losing settings
wargame.quests.6d6600000000100b.descript:
Back up settings and data before updating. Test recovery on a separate computer, then coordinate server and workstation updates. Use the official installer, not unverified mirrors.

Complete the objective and confirm manually; installation and connectivity are not checked automatically.
